Paired new-cohort H20 p50 improved model net_ann19.47%→29.49%, Sharpe0.281→0.494, fixed-s5 CAGR4.71%→23.13%, Sharpe0.304→0.856. Full review: docs/harness-trial-review.json.
reflections.interpretation: Observed patterns do not support the three frozen strict hypotheses. Return maxima agree between model/account (T20,D7,F15), Sharpe maxima differ for T/D and agree at F30. Three <=6-round selections, four reverse-priority-sensitive trajectories and one cap-censored fit limit causal H attribution. No ensemble falls below every component. Historical selection is not independent OOS, F is only136days in2024, historical v2 reproduction remains unresolved. Browser page layout QA blocked; source/links/static plots checked.
